As they pushed their grocery cart through the parking lot, they saw a red car pulling into the space next to their pick­up truck. He was now pulling a second wheel out when he looked up and saw Todd standing near him. Todd said, “Hi there! (C) As Todd finished loading his groceries, Greg’s door remained open. Todd noticed Greg didn’t get out of his car. But he was pulling something from his car. He put a metal frame on the ground beside his door. Remaining in the driver’s seat, he then reached back into (c)his car to grab something else. Todd realized what he was doing and considered whether (d)he should try to help him. After a moment, he decided to approach Greg. (D) After Todd and Ava climbed into their truck, Ava became curious.
